gaps.explanation: The governmental funds statement (p4) prints Loan proceeds 40,000 (Street column) under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES); total revenues 332,300. The Street Fund schedule (p14) prints the same Loan proceeds 40,000 among its REVENUES under 'Other' (Total other 40,300, TOTAL REVENUES 114,107 vs Street column revenues 74,107 on p4). Schedule 372,300 - 40,000 = 332,300 exactly. Presentation difference printed by the report itself (loan proceeds classified as revenue on the fund schedule, as other financing on the statement); the detail line follows the schedule's printed section, so no fix. All other governmental columns tie: General 219,373 (p11), Public Trust 27,030 (p21), Community Improvement 4,856 (p16), Cafe 907 (p19), Housing 2,447 (p20), Other Governmental Funds 3,580 = Cemetery 1,627 (p17) + Economic Development 7 (p18) + Medical Center 1,946 (p22).
